name: KV/Context Memory Mapping Design
head: d6310bcad95beaae19c083028d01a7216b22ec77

phase27h_d_summary.ws_6144: FAIL, score not established, swap 0.0GB, generation/API cliff

known_memory_facts: Swap held flat at 0.367-0.405GB across all Phase 27H runs
RAM stayed 7.0-7.6GB, never near the 3GB guard
qwen2.5:7b loads once, stays resident ~5.3GB RSS in Ollama
WS-512 through WS-4096 passed at c=2048/c=4096; WS-6144 failed at c=8192
Simple prompts at c=8192 work post-failure (confirmed with 'Testing. Say hello.')
qwen2.5:7b has 32K context window — capacity not the likely bottleneck

possible_failure_causes.cause: Ollama backend termination before output capture
possible_failure_causes.description: Ollama may have returned a non-200 status or closed the connection before curl captured the response body
possible_failure_causes.evidence: curl returned without parseable JSON; blank stderr; clean exit
possible_failure_causes.test: Capture raw HTTP response headers + status code + body

possible_failure_causes.cause: Internal attention/KV allocation at large context
possible_failure_causes.description: Combination of c=8192 + ~6K prompt may stall generation via attention computation issues
possible_failure_causes.evidence: Model responsive at c=8192 for tiny prompts; failure specific to large prompt+context combination
possible_failure_causes.test: Measure generation time per token; check if stall is during prompt_eval or eval

possible_failure_causes.description: DEBUG LOG filler + context headers may interact poorly with larger context window
possible_failure_causes.evidence: Simple prompts work; structured DEBUG LOG prompt did not
possible_failure_causes.test: Compare c=8192 with random filler vs structured DEBUG LOG filler

possible_failure_causes.description: Actual token count may exceed estimate; if >8K tokens, could exceed c=8192
possible_failure_causes.evidence: 32K window should hold 6K tokens, but estimate may be wrong
possible_failure_causes.test: Check actual token count via prompt_eval_count in Ollama response

possible_failure_causes.description: Ollama handling of num_ctx=8192 may have edge cases on this hardware
possible_failure_causes.evidence: Model works at c=8192 for tiny prompts; large prompts may trigger different code path
possible_failure_causes.test: Compare c=8192 behavior at various prompt sizes

possible_failure_causes.description: 240s timeout may fire during prompt_eval or generation at large context
possible_failure_causes.evidence: Wall time tracked but output not captured; process exited cleanly
possible_failure_causes.test: Check if timeout fires during prompt_eval or eval phase

test_a.name: c=8192 + tiny prompt
test_a.goal: Verify backend handles c=8192 for simple requests

test_b.name: c=8192 + medium filler prompt
test_b.goal: Test context size sensitivity with normal prompt structure

test_c.name: c=8192 + WS-6144 structured prompt
test_c.condition: only if tests A and B pass
test_c.goal: Confirm real cliff is prompt/context combination
test_c.pass_criteria: Correct answer or documented failure mode

future_safety_guard: Capture raw HTTP response headers + status + body + timing
No WS-8192, no c=16384, no broad eval suite
Stop on first backend failure — document and stop
recommended_next_phase: Phase 27J: c=8192 backend/API forensics — start with Test A (c=8192 + tiny prompt) to rule out infrastructure issue
